name: ai-cli-diff-view
description: Cursor-like inline diff review for any AI CLI agent's file edits, right inside VS Code

ai-cli-diff-view.supportedFileDetectionM.description: Controls whether AI CLI Diff View uses its built-in text file rules together with custom settings, or only the custom settings.

ai-cli-diff-view.supportedFileExtensions.description: Additional file extensions that AI CLI Diff View should treat as text files. Entries may be written with or without a leading dot.

ai-cli-diff-view.supportedFilenames.description: Additional exact filenames that AI CLI Diff View should treat as text files.

ai-cli-diff-view.supportedFilenamePatter.description: Additional filename glob patterns that AI CLI Diff View should treat as text files. Patterns match only the basename and support * and ? wildcards.

ai-cli-diff-view.maxFileLines.markdownDescription:
Advanced: ignore files longer than this many lines — no baseline is kept and no diff tab ever opens for them. Set to `0` to disable the limit.

Diff cost grows with the **square** of how many lines differ, so a large file that gets largely rewritten can block VS Code for seconds. Files that big are also almost always generated code, bundles or lock files rather than something reviewed hunk by hunk.

Why 5000: measured across `microsoft/vscode`, 99.8% of source files fall under it (median ~112 lines, p99 ~1980). Raise it if you genuinely review very large hand-written files — the TypeScript compiler's `checker.ts` is 54,433 lines — and accept that opening such a diff may stall the editor.

ai-cli-diff-view.baselineScanConcurrency.description: Advanced: maximum number of files read concurrently during the initial baseline scan. Lower this for very large or remote workspaces.

ai-cli-diff-view.burstDetectionEnabled.description: Advanced: when many files change within a short window (e.g. git checkout, branch switch), hold files beyond the threshold to confirm whether it's really a git operation before opening a diff, instead of opening one immediately.

ai-cli-diff-view.burstDetectionWindowMs.description: Advanced: sliding time window (ms) used to count how many files changed in quick succession for burst detection.

ai-cli-diff-view.burstDetectionThreshold.description: Advanced: number of distinct files changed within the burst window that counts as a batch operation (e.g. git checkout) rather than an AI tool edit.

ai-cli-diff-view.burstDetectionHoldMs.description: Advanced: how long (ms) to hold files beyond the burst threshold before opening their diff, if no git branch change gets confirmed in that time.

ai-cli-diff-view.soundNotificationsEnabl.description: Play a sound when Claude finishes a turn or needs input (Windows only). Writes Notification/Stop hooks to ~/.claude/settings.json.
